observations: Two high outer triangular brick gables, two central small attic sash windows, tall chimney stacks.
Three main storeys; white small-pane glazing, segmental lower heads and dark projecting horizontal brick courses.
Central double-arched recessed portico, balustraded balcony and raised entry terrace.
Photo shows entire listed pair, and is not proof of a separate frontage on a northern OSM building polygon.
